critical_code_review_comments: reference_routes.upload_reference silently swallows docx/pdf parse errors with a broad 'except Exception: pass' before falling back to extract_cv_text. This is fine for UX but means truly corrupt files may still be accepted if extract_cv_text returns any text. Consider surfacing the parse error in logs.

reference_context selects up to 6 docs but only ever concatenates the first 2 slices (docs[:2]). If the founder later approves more references, some approved material would be silently unused — either raise the slice cap or document this behavior in the admin UI.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite for the reference library + Module 1 blueprint is at /app/backend/tests/test_reference_library.py. Requires REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL to be set in env when running pytest (or via -o addopts=''). The suite issues ONE Claude call — do not run it in tight loops (mind the EMERGENT_LLM_KEY budget). Founder doc reference_id is 860f14a8d196abf2 and MUST be left approved=false. If OWNER_RECRUITMENT_REVIEW_MODE flips off, the blueprint test will regress because it relies on the admin cookie flowing to /api/members/me via review-mode fallback.
